critical_code_review_comments: KnowledgeCenter.jsx now at 799 lines — well past the 700-line split threshold flagged in iteration_178. Recommend extracting InspectorPane (~120 lines including parseRegistryMeta + kc-registry-details block) and SearchPanel into separate files.

parseRegistryMeta is a client-side markdown parser that runs on every inspector open — could be memoized with useMemo keyed on the raw markdown to avoid re-parsing when other state changes. Non-blocking micro-optimization.

REGISTRY empty-state check: line 758 `filtered = artifactFilter ? scoped.filter(...)` correctly returns kc-artifact-empty only when zero matches. With REGISTRY=1, empty state now correctly hidden. No dead-code path — good.

PATH_ARTIFACT_TYPE_RULES is a single-entry list [('memory/registries/', 'REGISTRY')]. As more artifact types (GRAPH/LEDGER/INDEX/CATALOG) get canonical locations, ensure the list stays ordered by specificity (longer path prefixes first) to avoid mis-detection.

Backend /api/founder/knowledge/search endpoint does NOT parse 'artifact:REGISTRY' as an operator (returns 0 for that raw query). This is intentional per spec — token parsing is fully client-side and search only sends free text to backend. Documented in code comment at line 330.
